rinoplasti.title: Rhinoplasty (Nose Surgery)
rinoplasti.subtitle: Synchronization of Aesthetics and Breathing Function
rinoplasti.content: Rhinoplasty surgery does not only change external appearance, but also optimizes the breathing function that directly affects your quality of life. Before each operation, the person's facial structure, chin angle, and forehead distance are analyzed to determine the anatomy that will look most natural.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Detailed answers to everything you might wonder about from preoperative consultation to recovery.

items.q: How is 3D simulation and planning performed before surgery?
items.a: During the initial consultation, your facial features are digitized using 3D facial analysis technology. A personalized nose design tailored to your natural anatomy is created based on golden ratio principles.

items.q: What are the advantages of Ultrasonic (Piezo) Rhinoplasty?
items.a: Unlike traditional breaking methods, Piezo technology precisely shapes bone tissue using sound waves. Soft tissues and blood vessels remain undamaged, resulting in minimal post-operative swelling and bruising.

items.q: Are silicone splints or cloth packings used during surgery?
items.a: To ensure maximum breathing comfort, we use grooved silicone splints that do not block airflow. Removing them takes just seconds and is virtually painless.

items.q: How does the recovery process progress after surgery?
items.a: Mild swelling may occur in the first 2-3 days. On day 7, the protective splint and silicone tubes are removed. Patients can comfortably return to work and social life after week 1.

items.q: When does the nose take its final shape?
items.a: Around 80% of swelling resolves within the first 1-2 months. Complete resolution of minor edema takes 6-12 months for thin skin and 1-1.5 years for thick-skinned patients.

items.q: When can I wear glasses and resume sports after surgery?
items.a: Light walking can start from week 2. Heavy sports and swimming require waiting for 1 month. Wearing sunglasses is recommended after 2-3 months to allow proper bone healing.

items.q: What is Revision Rhinoplasty and when should it be done?
items.a: It is a corrective procedure for patients who underwent previous surgery elsewhere but experience aesthetic or breathing issues. At least 1 year must pass from the first operation for tissue healing.

items.q: Is rib cartilage always required in revision surgery?
items.a: If insufficient cartilage remains inside the nose, micro grafts are harvested from the patient's rib or ear cartilage to rebuild structure and support.

items.q: Can Otoplasty or Bichectomy be combined with Rhinoplasty?
items.a: Yes, combined procedures such as Otoplasty (Ear Aesthetic) or Bichectomy (Cheek Reduction) are frequently performed under a single anesthesia session to enhance overall facial symmetry.

items.q: Can deviated septum and enlarged turbinates be treated simultaneously with aesthetics?
items.a: Aesthetic rhinoplasty and functional treatments for deviated septum or enlarged turbinates (nasal flesh) are routinely performed together in our clinic.

otoplasti.title: Bandage & First Check
otoplasti.desc: Special protective bandage is applied; no pain hindering social life is felt.
otoplasti.tip: Pressure should not be applied to the ear.

otoplasti.title: Bandage Removal
otoplasti.desc: Behind-the-ear stitches are checked, transitioning to a light headband.
otoplasti.tip: A protective headband should be worn at night.

otoplasti.title: Settling of Angles
otoplasti.desc: Ear folds and head angle reach 90% of their final form.

bisektomi.title: Edema & Liquid Diet
bisektomi.desc: Liquid/soft foods are preferred on the first day due to intraoral micro-incisions.
bisektomi.tip: Antiseptic mouthwashes should not be neglected.

bisektomi.title: Edema Resolution
bisektomi.desc: Most of the swelling in the cheeks disperses, stitches begin to dissolve.
bisektomi.tip: Extremely hot foods should be avoided.

bisektomi.title: V-Line Definition
bisektomi.desc: Cheek hollows become clear, cheekbones come to the forefront.
bisektomi.tip: Gentle facial massages can be started.

bisektomi.title: Sharp Jawlines
bisektomi.desc: Facial contour and Hollywood cheek form settle 100%.
bisektomi.tip: The final aesthetic line is achieved.

default.title: Discharge & Cold Application
default.desc: A comfortable resting period with silicone splints allowing breathing.
default.tip: The head should be elevated at 45 degrees.

default.title: Splint Removal
default.desc: Splints and silicones are removed painlessly. The first new nose shape is seen.
default.tip: Warm showers can be taken, nose is taped.

default.title: Edema Distribution & Easy Breathing
default.desc: 80% of gross edema dissolves. Facial expression becomes natural.
default.tip: Light walks and sports can be started.

default.title: Anatomic Settling & Golden Ratio
default.desc: Fine tissue edemas resolve, nose tip takes its final shape.
